stalls.summaryZh: 從舊梧棲夜市搬來的排隊名攤，現煎底部酥脆。
stalls.summaryEn: A long-queue favourite moved from the old Wuqi market; dumplings fried to order with crisp bottoms.

sources.title: 食尚玩家 梧棲中港觀光夜市（2024-09）
食尚玩家 台中夜市懶人包（2025-11）

stalls.summaryZh: 一碗附白飯、湯與飲料，份量大很划算。
stalls.summaryEn: One bowl comes with rice, soup and a drink; big portions for the price.

stalls.summaryZh: 孜然羊肉串香氣重，多買更划算。
stalls.summaryEn: Cumin-heavy lamb skewers, cheaper by the bundle.

sources.title: 食尚玩家 梧棲中港觀光夜市（2024-09）

stalls.summaryZh: 整隻刷醬碳烤的魷魚，彈牙有嚼勁。
stalls.summaryEn: Whole squid brushed with sauce and charcoal-grilled, springy and chewy.

sources.title: 食尚玩家 梧棲中港觀光夜市（2024-09）

stalls.summaryZh: 大片手工蔥油餅可買半片，酥香不油膩。
stalls.summaryEn: Big handmade scallion pancakes sold by the half or whole, crisp without being greasy.
